synthesis.executive_summary: 本期日报覆盖9篇论文，核心趋势包括：人在回路标注效率提升（GAIDA）、合成数据与注意力机制改进版面检测（DocLayout-YOLO）、评估中事实冗余问题（One Fact Many Places）、真实数据驱动的场景文本编辑（TextRIRO）、覆盖层去除（DeOverlay）等。这些工作共同反映了文档解析向更实用、更鲁棒和更公平评估方向发展的趋势，其中合成数据预训练和真实数据自监督成为提升模型适应性的关键手段。工程上，GAIDA和DocLayout-YOLO提供了可直接集成的工具链，而评估工作提醒需要重新审视检索与归因指标。
synthesis.trend_summary: 文档解析研究正从追求完全自动化转向人机协同与可解释增强，同时合成数据预训练和真实数据自监督策略并行发展；评估方面开始重视事实冗余对单金标指标的破坏，推动更鲁棒的基准设计；视频文档处理中覆盖层去除和长视频摘要工具化成为新增长点。
common_innovations: 将OCR与LLM预标注集成到可编辑的人机协同工作流中，以降低标注成本。
利用合成文档数据预训练版面检测模型，提升对异构文档的泛化能力。
引入页面轴注意力机制捕捉版面元素的长程空间依赖。
使用显著性图指导低资源手写字符识别的数据增强，并提出可解释性一致性指标。
通过破坏真实图像构建自配对数据，避免场景文本编辑对合成配对数据的依赖。
采用源锚定流匹配进行视频覆盖层去除，并构建配对视频基准。
递归深度语言模型在临床多任务NLP上以更小参数量达到或超越标准Transformer。
跨层增量状态传播机制增强神经算子对细尺度流场的重建能力。
递归分解视频并自适应调用OCR/ASR等外部工具，以改善长视频摘要的语义丰富度。
future_directions: 开发多标注者一致性感知的人在回路标注框架，并研究预标注错误如何影响标注质量与效率的权衡。
探索显著性约束增强在印刷体、场景文本等其他OCR任务上的泛化性，并分析ECI与模型鲁棒性的理论关联。
研究合成数据与真实数据在版面检测预训练中的最优混合比例，以及针对极端长尾版面的合成数据生成策略。
设计多证据感知的检索与引用评估协议，并开发可扩展的自动事实副本发现方法，减少人工标注依赖。
探索场景文本编辑中自配对策略向多语言和复杂排版的扩展，并优化扩散模型的推理速度以满足实时需求。
将视频覆盖层去除模型与OCR流水线端到端联合优化，评估去除质量对下游文本识别准确率的影响。
研究递归深度语言模型在临床文档OCR后结构化抽取任务上的表现，并设计消融实验分离递归深度与参数量的贡献。
将跨层增量状态机制迁移到其他物理场预测任务，并探索状态压缩以控制计算开销。
研究长视频摘要中工具调用链的错误传播机制，设计校验与回退策略，并量化OCR工具输出与视觉信息对齐对摘要忠实度的影响。
engineering_takeaways: GAIDA的人机协同标注架构可显著减少标注时间（最高80.9%），适合快速构建领域数据集，但需注意预标注F1有限，应保留人工审查环节。
DocLayout-YOLO提供实时版面检测和开源合成数据集MeshLayout-1M，可直接集成到文档解析流水线，提升异构文档处理效率。
评估文档理解系统时需考虑事实冗余，避免单金标指标低估检索与引用性能，建议采用集合级评估或自动副本发现。
TextRIRO表明仅用真实数据自配对训练可缓解合成到真实的域差距，并生成大规模识别数据，适合提升OCR识别模型的真实场景性能。
DeOverlay为视频OCR预处理提供有效覆盖层去除方案，并开源DVTE-Bench基准，便于标准化评估。
递归深度模型在临床多任务NLP上以更小参数达到可比性能，可降低资源受限环境的部署成本。

papers.title: GAIDA: Generative AI for Human-in-the-Loop Document Annotation
papers.summary: Document annotation is a fundamental yet labor-intensive step in building document information extraction systems. While Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and Large Language Models (LLMs) can automate parts of this process, we argue that annotation systems should be judged not by how completely they remove human effort, but by how effectively they redirect it toward review and correction. We propose a modular human-in-the-loop architecture that integrates OCR-based extraction, LLM-based semantic pre-annotation, and human validation in a single editable workflow, and present \textbf{GAIDA}, a research prototype serving as its reference implementation. GAIDA supports interchangeable OCR engines, LLM backends, and prompt configurations, and enables stage-specific measurement of annotation effort. In an initial single-annotator, stage-specific study on the FUNSD scanned-form and WildReceipt retail-receipt benchmarks, OCR assistance reduced region-creation and transcription time by up to \textbf{80.9\%}, and reviewing LLM pre-annotations reduced semantic-labeling time by up to \textbf{73.7\%}, despite imperfect pre-annotations of 78.86\% and 86.98\% Micro F1 on FUNSD and WildReceipt, respectively. Finally, we reuse the same implementation, adapting only OCR and prompt configuration, to build and openly release \textbf{AraReceipt}, a manually annotated dataset of 100 Arabic receipt images labeled with 25 key-information classes. The results indicate that imperfect automated outputs provide practical value when presented as editable suggestions under human control.
papers.zh_summary: 论文提出GAIDA，一个模块化的人在回路文档标注架构，集成了基于OCR的提取、基于LLM的语义预标注和人工验证，形成可编辑的工作流。在FUNSD扫描表单和WildReceipt零售收据基准上进行的初步单标注者、阶段特定研究表明，OCR辅助将区域创建和转录时间最多减少80.9%，审查LLM预标注将语义标注时间最多减少73.7%，尽管预标注在FUNSD和WildReceipt上的Micro F1分别为78.86%和86.98%。最后，作者复用同一实现构建并开源了AraReceipt数据集，包含100张阿拉伯语收据图像和25个关键信息类别的标注。
papers.novelty: 提出了一种以人为中心、强调将人工努力重定向至审查与纠正的文档标注架构，而非追求完全自动化；实现了OCR、LLM和人工验证的可编辑集成工作流，并支持阶段特定的效率测量。
innovation_points: 模块化人在回路架构，支持可互换的OCR引擎、LLM后端和提示配置，便于灵活调整和阶段级效率评估。
将LLM预标注与人工验证紧密结合，强调不完美自动化输出的实用价值，并通过可编辑建议界面实现人机协同。
通过复用实现并仅调整OCR和提示配置，构建并开源了阿拉伯语收据数据集AraReceipt，展示了架构的跨语言/领域适应性。
papers.limitations: 初步研究仅涉及单一标注者，样本和评估范围有限；预标注的Micro F1在FUNSD上仅为78.86%，仍有较大提升空间；未报告多标注者一致性或大规模用户研究。
papers.engineering_value: 为文档信息提取系统的标注环节提供了可落地的人在回路工具链，能显著降低标注成本（时间减少73.7%-80.9%），并支持快速适配新语言/领域（如阿拉伯语收据），具有较高的工程实用价值。
papers.why_relevant: 论文直接涉及OCR与LLM结合的文档标注流程，属于文档解析与信息提取的前沿工程实践，且提供了开源数据集和原型系统，对OCR应用落地有参考意义。

papers.title: What Not to Erase: Saliency-Constrained Augmentation for Low-Resource Handwritten Character Recognition
papers.summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and handwritten character recognition (HCR) in low-resource historical material collections often rely on data augmentation, yet augmentation strategies are typically evaluated almost exclusively through predictive accuracy. This leaves open whether a model's improved performance is accompanied by saliency stability. This question is important in low-resource historical HCR, where recognition is performed on variable and partially degraded letterforms and two models with similar predictive performance may differ in how consistently their saliency patterns respond to such variation. We therefore study saliency-guided augmentation as an explanation-aware strategy for low-resource HCR. Rather than treating saliency maps only as post-hoc interpretations, we use them to define augmentation variants that perturb, preserve, or constrain visually informative regions of character images. We compare classical document-style transformations, random lacunae, and several saliency-constrained lacuna variants. To evaluate the effect of augmentation beyond accuracy, we introduce the Explainability Consistency Index (ECI), a metric that quantifies the stability of saliency patterns under controlled perturbations. We find that saliency-constrained augmentation can improve recognition over classical augmentation, but no single saliency strategy is consistently best. The preferred form of the constraint varies with both architecture and corpus, indicating that saliency is better treated as a mechanism for controlling augmentation than as a fixed augmentation strategy. In some settings, saliency-constrained training improves explanation consistency even when predictive performance is similar. This shows that predictive metrics alone can obscure differences in model sensitivity under perturbation, motivating explanation consistency as a complementary evaluation dimension.
papers.zh_summary: 论文研究低资源历史手写字符识别（HCR）中的数据增强问题，指出仅用预测准确率评估增强策略的不足，提出关注显著性稳定性。作者将显著性图用于定义增强变体（扰动、保留或约束字符图像中的视觉信息区域），比较经典文档变换、随机空缺和显著性约束空缺变体，并引入可解释性一致性指数（ECI）量化显著性模式在受控扰动下的稳定性。实验发现显著性约束增强可提升识别性能，但最佳约束形式随架构和语料变化。
papers.novelty: 将显著性图从后验解释工具转变为增强策略的设计依据，首次在低资源HCR中系统研究增强对显著性稳定性的影响，并提出ECI度量。
innovation_points: 提出显著性引导的增强范式，通过扰动、保留或约束视觉信息区域生成增强样本，而非仅做传统变换。
引入Explainability Consistency Index（ECI），量化模型显著性模式在扰动下的稳定性，补充准确率之外的评估维度。
实验表明显著性约束增强可超越经典增强，但最优策略依赖于架构和数据集，强调显著性作为控制增强的机制而非固定增强方式。
papers.limitations: 研究局限于低资源历史手写字符识别，未验证在其他OCR任务（如印刷体、场景文本）上的普适性；ECI作为新指标，其与模型鲁棒性的理论联系尚需进一步分析；最佳显著性策略需针对每个架构和语料调优，增加了实际应用成本。
papers.engineering_value: 为低资源手写识别提供了一种可解释性驱动的数据增强思路，有助于在历史文档数字化等场景中提升模型鲁棒性，但需针对具体任务调整策略，工程落地需权衡调优成本。
papers.why_relevant: 论文聚焦OCR/HCR中的数据增强与可解释性，属于OCR模型鲁棒性研究的前沿方向，对低资源场景下的OCR系统开发有参考价值。

papers.title: DocLayout-YOLO: Axis-Attentive Document Layout Detector with Mesh-Guided Synthetic Pretraining
papers.summary: Accurate and efficient document layout analysis is critical for modern document parsing systems. However, although the YOLO framework represents a leading paradigm for the real-time detector, its adaptation to heterogeneous documents remains underexplored. To address this gap, we propose DocLayout-YOLO, a document-specialized real-time detector that integrates diverse synthetic document pretraining and page-axis context modeling. From the data perspective, we introduce MeshLayout-1M, a synthetic pretraining corpus generated by the proposed Mesh-candidate BestFit algorithm, which provides large-scale and diverse document layouts for pretraining and improves adaptation to heterogeneous document scenarios. From the model perspective, we propose Page-Axis Layout Attention (PALA), which captures long-range dependencies along the horizontal and vertical page axes while remaining computationally efficient. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DocLayout-YOLO achieves state-of-the-art performance on four heterogeneous document benchmarks, obtaining 72.4%/75.5%/96.0%/73.1% mAP50:95 on D4LA, M6Doc, HJDataset, and PRIMA-LAD, respectively. Compared with existing real-time detectors, DocLayout-YOLO establishes a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off in document layout analysis. Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/opendatalab/DocLayout-YOLO/tree/release-v2.
papers.zh_summary: 论文提出DocLayout-YOLO，一种面向异构文档的实时版面检测器，集成了多样化的合成文档预训练和页面轴上下文建模。数据方面，提出Mesh-candidate BestFit算法生成合成预训练语料MeshLayout-1M；模型方面，提出Page-Axis Layout Attention（PALA）捕捉页面水平和垂直轴上的长程依赖。在四个异构文档基准上取得最先进性能，mAP50:95分别为72.4%/75.5%/96.0%/73.1%，在准确性与效率之间取得优异平衡。
papers.novelty: 将合成文档预训练与页面轴注意力机制结合，专门针对YOLO框架在异构文档版面分析中的适配进行改进。
innovation_points: 提出Mesh-candidate BestFit算法生成大规模多样化合成文档布局数据集MeshLayout-1M，用于预训练以提升异构文档适应性。
设计Page-Axis Layout Attention（PALA），沿页面水平和垂直轴高效捕捉长程依赖，增强版面元素的空间关系建模。
在多个异构文档基准上实现SOTA实时检测性能，并开源代码、模型和数据。
papers.limitations: 方法基于YOLO框架，可能受限于其固有检测范式；合成数据与真实文档分布仍可能存在差距；未详细讨论极端长尾或复杂嵌套版面的表现。
papers.engineering_value: 提供了可直接用于文档解析流水线的实时版面检测器，开源了大规模合成数据集和模型，对构建高效文档理解系统具有较高工程价值。
papers.why_relevant: 版面分析是OCR文档解析的关键前置环节，该论文提出高效的实时检测方案并开源资源，对OCR系统集成和文档结构化有直接帮助。

papers.title: One Fact, Many Places: Redundant Evidence in Long Visual Documents Breaks Single-Gold Evaluation of Retrieval, Citation and Attribution
papers.summary: Document understanding is increasingly judged on where an answer comes from, scored against annotated gold locations as if each fact lived in one place. In long visual documents, a fact often lives in several places: a chart value is restated in the text, a key figure reappears in the summary. We ask how often such copies occur in standard benchmarks and what they do to evaluation. We annotate 420 questions from MMLongBench-Doc and MMDocRAG with the locations that independently establish each required fact, checked by two independent reviewers. Copies are common and often cross-modal: 19.5% of MMLongBench-Doc test questions have a strict copy outside the gold, and in 28% of MMDocRAG questions a non-gold candidate alone supplies a required fact. Single-gold scoring then fails in three predictable ways. A retriever that finds a copy is scored as a miss: page recall@1 of text and visual retrievers is underestimated by 13-24 points on questions with a cross-page copy. A model that cites a copy is scored as citing wrongly: crediting equivalent evidence reverses 11% of pairwise orderings among 65 competitive MMDocRAG systems. Masking the gold region leaves the fact available elsewhere: with a copy in the input, 41-56% of correct answers across four models survive it yet fail once every annotated instance is masked. Set-level masking with automatically found copies closes 78% of the gap to masking every annotated instance at matched granularity (three models); an unverified key-string rule lowers survival at least as far but masks three times the area. We release the annotations and redundancy-aware metrics.
papers.zh_summary: 论文指出长视觉文档中同一事实常出现在多个位置，而当前基于单一金标位置的评估方式会误导检索、引用和归因评价。作者对MMLongBench-Doc和MMDocRAG的420个问题标注了独立确立每个所需事实的多个位置，发现副本常见且常跨模态：19.5%的MMLongBench-Doc测试问题在gold外存在严格副本，28%的MMDocRAG问题中非gold候选单独提供所需事实。单金标评分导致三类失败：检索器找到副本被误判为未命中（页面recall@1低估13-24点）；模型引用副本被误判为错误引用（逆转11%的成对排序）；掩码gold区域后事实仍可从副本获得，导致正确回答存活。作者提出集合级掩码与自动发现副本的方法，缩小78%的差距。
papers.novelty: 首次系统性地量化长视觉文档中事实冗余对单金标评估的破坏，并揭示其对检索、引用和归因任务的连锁影响。
innovation_points: 对标准基准中的多位置证据进行人工标注，揭示事实副本的普遍性和跨模态特性。
系统分析单金标评分在检索、引用和归因评估中的三类错误模式，并通过实验证明其影响程度。
提出集合级掩码和自动副本发现方法，为更公平的评估提供可行方案。
papers.limitations: 标注规模有限（420个问题），可能未覆盖所有文档类型；自动副本发现方法依赖规则，可能引入噪声；未提出完整的替代评估协议或修正所有基准。
papers.engineering_value: 提醒工程实践中评估文档理解系统时需考虑事实冗余，推动更公平的评估工具和数据集构建，对检索、引用和归因模块的研发有指导意义。
papers.why_relevant: 论文涉及文档理解评估中的证据定位问题，与OCR后的信息检索和归因紧密相关，对构建可靠的文档问答系统有重要参考价值。

papers.title: Real In, Real Out: What If We Only Use Real Data for Scene Text Editing?
papers.summary: Aiming to modify textual content while preserving the original style, Scene Text Editing (STE) has significant practical value in many applications. STE typically requires paired images before and after editing for training. However, recent approaches rely heavily on synthetic paired data and complex disentanglement strategies. They struggle to faithfully capture the diversity and complexity of natural scenes, often producing artifacts or hallucinations. In this work, we challenge the common practice and investigate whether STE can be driven by turning each real sample into its own paired supervision. Concretely, we explore multiple ways to disrupt the original image (e.g., Crop, Shuffle, Mask) to construct self-paired training data, and build a strong baseline (TextRIRO}) upon a conditional diffusion architecture. Our experiments show that combining character-column shuffling with image cropping (Shuffle&Crop) effectively destroys text semantics while preserving key style cues, enabling the model to learn editing behaviors directly from the real text image. With this concise yet real-oriented design, TextRIRO achieves promising performance in both accuracy and visual realism across real-world benchmarks, substantially mitigating the synthetic-to-real domain gap. Furthermore, we leverage TextRIRO to build TextRIRO-3M, a large-scale realistic dataset for long-text recognition by concatenating edited and original images. Experimental results show that training recognition models with TextRIRO-3M significantly improves recognition accuracy, demonstrating that TextRIRO provides highly useful training resources for downstream tasks. Overall, TextRIRO lifts STE to realistic, reliable, and widely applicable new levels. Code is available at https://github.com/YesianRohn/TextRIRO.
papers.zh_summary: 论文挑战场景文本编辑（STE）依赖合成配对数据的常见做法，探索仅使用真实数据驱动STE。通过破坏原始图像（如裁剪、打乱、掩码）构建自配对训练数据，提出基于条件扩散架构的强基线TextRIRO。实验表明字符列打乱与图像裁剪结合能有效破坏文本语义同时保留风格线索，使模型直接从真实文本图像学习编辑行为。在真实基准上取得有前景的准确性和视觉真实感，显著缓解合成到真实的域差距。作者还利用TextRIRO构建了大规模真实长文本识别数据集TextRIRO-3M，训练识别模型显著提升准确率。
papers.novelty: 首次系统研究仅使用真实图像自配对监督进行场景文本编辑，避免对合成配对数据的依赖和复杂解耦策略。
innovation_points: 提出多种破坏原始图像构建自配对数据的方式（裁剪、打乱、掩码），并发现Shuffle&Crop组合能最佳平衡语义破坏与风格保留。
构建基于条件扩散的TextRIRO基线，直接从真实文本图像学习编辑，减少合成到真实域差距。
利用编辑能力构建大规模真实长文本识别数据集TextRIRO-3M，反哺OCR识别任务。
papers.limitations: 方法主要针对英文场景文本，未验证多语言或复杂排版；自配对策略可能不适用于所有编辑类型（如任意字体替换）；扩散模型生成速度可能限制实时应用。
papers.engineering_value: 为场景文本编辑提供了一条不依赖合成配对数据的实用路径，并能生成大规模真实训练数据以提升OCR识别性能，具有较高的应用潜力。
papers.why_relevant: 论文直接关联OCR中的场景文本编辑与数据增强，且展示了生成数据对识别任务的提升，对OCR数据构建和模型训练有启发意义。

papers.title: DeOverlay: A Benchmark and Source-Anchored Flow for Video Overlay Removal
papers.summary: Video overlay removal aims to recover scenes obscured by subtitles, titles, and logos while preserving surrounding content. Existing methods use temporal propagation or source-conditioned generation, but can leave residual overlays and distort scene structure when useful source information is obscured. We propose DeOverlay, a source-anchored flow model that reconstructs the clean video from the source latent with fixed source guidance. Specifically, we train a shared velocity network along paired source-to-clean paths using region-weighted flow matching, enabling successive cor- rections from intermediate states. To select local source cues, we develop visibility-normalized temporal aggregation that excludes masked positions and averages the remaining observations. Global source context and edit-region embeddings complement these cues through additive condi- tioning, retaining a single video-token sequence. To evaluate scene recovery across diverse overlay conditions, we introduce DVTE-Bench, comprising 1,631 paired videos across eight text-overlay categories, with OCR-screened clean targets, frame-aligned pixel masks, and a common evaluation protocol. Experiments on the complete release show that DeOverlay outperforms four baselines on all five reconstruction and perceptual metrics, reducing Mask LPIPS and Mask VFID by 58.3% and 70.3%, respectively, relative to the strongest evaluated baseline. Additional qualitative examples demonstrate the removal of graphic logos and stickers. We will make the complete benchmark, evaluation code, and test outputs availabl. Project page:https://yahooo-m.github.io/DVTE-Bench/
papers.zh_summary: 论文提出DeOverlay，一种源锚定流模型，用于视频覆盖层去除（如字幕、标题、标志），从源潜在表示和固定源引导重建干净视频。通过区域加权流匹配训练共享速度网络，沿配对源到干净路径进行连续修正。开发可见性归一化时间聚合以选择局部源线索，并辅以全局源上下文和编辑区域嵌入。同时引入DVTE-Bench基准，包含1,631对视频、八种文本覆盖类别、OCR筛选的干净目标和帧对齐像素掩码。实验表明DeOverlay在五项重建和感知指标上优于四个基线，Mask LPIPS和Mask VFID分别降低58.3%和70.3%。
papers.novelty: 将流匹配与源锚定引导结合用于视频覆盖层去除，并构建了多样化的配对视频基准DVTE-Bench。
innovation_points: 提出源锚定流模型，利用固定源引导和区域加权流匹配从中间状态进行连续修正，减少残留覆盖和结构失真。
设计可见性归一化时间聚合，排除被掩码位置并平均剩余观察，有效选择局部源线索；结合全局上下文和编辑区域嵌入的加性条件。
构建DVTE-Bench基准，包含1,631对视频、八类文本覆盖、OCR筛选目标和统一评估协议，推动该任务标准化评估。
papers.limitations: 方法主要针对文本覆盖，对复杂图形标志和贴纸的去除仅提供定性示例；基准规模有限；流模型推理效率未详细讨论。
papers.engineering_value: 为视频文档中的覆盖层去除提供了有效的模型和基准，对视频OCR预处理、文档视频净化等场景有工程应用价值。
papers.why_relevant: 视频覆盖层去除是OCR预处理的重要环节，尤其对于含字幕/标志的视频文档解析，该论文提供了新方法和评估基准。

papers.title: Exploring Recurrent-Depth Language Models for Multitask Clinical Text Processing
papers.summary: Clinical natural language processing includes diverse tasks such as information extraction, classification, and question answering. Developing one model for all tasks could simplify deployment and improve knowledge transfer. We evaluated whether small recurrent-depth language models can meet this need through joint fine-tuning and compared their performance with standard transformers. We fine-tuned Ouro1.4B-Thinking, Ouro-2.6B-Thinking, HRM-Text-1B, Qwen3-1.7B, and Qwen3-8B on 9 datasets covering information extraction, classification, inference, and question answering, and evaluated them on four additional datasets excluded from training. Across these 13 datasets, Ouro-1.4B-Thinking achieved higher performances than Qwen3-1.7B on 11 datasets; Ouro-2.6BThinking was competitive with Qwen3-8B on most tasks. Ouro models showed the largest gains on inference and question answering, whereas HRM-Text-1B showed mixed results. These findings support further study of recurrent-depth models for clinical tasks through controlled experiments to isolate architectural effects and investigate how recurrent computation influences reasoning, knowledge acquisition, and generalization.
papers.zh_summary: 该研究评估小型递归深度语言模型（Ouro系列、HRM-Text）在临床多任务文本处理上的联合微调表现，与Qwen3标准Transformer对比。在覆盖信息抽取、分类、推断和问答共13个数据集上，Ouro-1.4B-Thinking在11个数据集上优于Qwen3-1.7B，Ouro-2.6B-Thinking在多数任务上与Qwen3-8B相当，尤其在推断和问答任务上增益最大；HRM-Text-1B结果不一致。
papers.novelty: 将递归深度架构系统性地引入临床多任务NLP场景，并与同规模及更大规模标准Transformer进行控制性对比，而非仅报告单一任务效果。
innovation_points: 在9个训练集上联合微调递归深度模型，并在4个未参与训练的留出集上检验跨任务泛化
以参数量匹配的Qwen3-1.7B为基线，分离架构差异与规模差异
发现递归计算对推断与问答类任务增益最明显，提示其与多步推理的关联
papers.limitations: ['仅对比少数模型与数据集，未做多种子或显著性检验', '未隔离递归深度与其他架构/训练细节的混杂影响', '未分析临床文本特有的长文档、缩写与领域术语处理表现']
improvement_directions: 设计消融实验固定参数量与预训练数据，单独度量递归深度步数对推理任务的影响
将递归深度模型应用于临床长文档OCR后文本的结构化抽取与字段归一化
考察递归计算在低资源临床任务上的知识迁移与灾难性遗忘行为
papers.engineering_value: 若递归深度模型能以更小参数达到大模型的多任务水平，可降低临床NLP本地化部署的显存与推理成本，适合资源受限的院内系统。
papers.why_relevant: 涉及信息抽取与多任务联合建模，其结论可指导OCR后临床文档的下游结构化处理模型选型。

papers.title: CIS-Transolver: A Cross-Layer Incremental-State Neural Operator for Fine-Scale Automotive Aerodynamic Flow Prediction
papers.summary: Neural operators offer an efficient data-driven approach to rapid prediction of complex automotive aerodynamic flows. However, spectral bias and other factors limit accurate reconstruction of fine-scale flow variations near complex geometries. Existing studies improve the representation and fitting of fine-scale information mainly through information extraction and training objectives. Further study is needed to determine how extracted local details can be used continually in subsequent operator computations and contribute effectively to the overall flow-field representation. We propose CIS-Transolver, a cross-layer incremental-state neural operator that extends fine-scale modeling from local information extraction to its use across layers. The method extracts fine-scale information through local multiscale analysis and encodes it as geometric moment states that are propagated and updated across layers. By combining information from previous layers with feedback to the value representations in Physics-Attention, the method allows local details to contribute continually to subsequent modeling of global physical correlations. We systematically evaluate CIS-Transolver on three public automotive aerodynamics benchmarks, ShapeNet-Car, AhmedML, and DrivAerNet++, covering surface pressure fields and volumetric pressure and velocity fields. CIS-Transolver achieves the lowest mean relative L2 error among the evaluated methods for all five prediction metrics across the three benchmarks. The relative error reductions average 8.72% across the five metrics compared with the best baseline for each metric, reaching 16.38% for ShapeNet-Car pressure prediction and 15.60% for AhmedML velocity prediction. These results provide a new approach to fine-scale flow prediction for complex geometries.
papers.zh_summary: 针对汽车气动流场预测中神经算子对复杂几何附近细尺度流动重建不足的问题，提出CIS-Transolver跨层增量状态神经算子。方法通过局部多尺度分析提取细尺度信息并编码为几何矩状态，在层间传播更新，并反馈至Physics-Attention的值表示。在ShapeNet-Car、AhmedML、DrivAerNet++三个基准的表面压力场与体压力/速度场上，五项指标均取得最低平均相对L2误差，平均相对误差降低8.72%。
papers.novelty: 将细尺度建模从单次局部特征提取扩展为跨层持续传播的增量状态机制，使局部细节在后续全局物理关联建模中反复参与。
innovation_points: 提出几何矩状态作为细尺度信息的跨层载体，实现层间增量传播与更新
将前层信息反馈到Physics-Attention的值表示，耦合局部细节与全局物理相关建模
在三个公开汽车气动基准的五项预测指标上统一验证改进
papers.limitations: ['摘要未给出推理时延与显存开销，跨层状态传播可能增加计算成本', '仅限汽车气动场景，对其他几何或物理场泛化性未验证', '相对误差降低幅度有限，细尺度高频结构仍可能存在谱偏差']
improvement_directions: 报告跨层状态传播的推理开销，并探索状态压缩以控制成本
将该机制迁移到其他PDE预测任务以检验泛化
针对高频细节引入频域监督或谱一致性损失以进一步缓解谱偏差
papers.engineering_value: 面向汽车外形设计迭代的快速气动评估，误差降低可直接减少CFD高保真仿真调用次数，具备工程落地潜力。
papers.why_relevant: 虽非OCR任务，但其多尺度局部细节提取与跨层传播思路可借鉴到文档图像中细小文本区域的特征增强。

papers.title: Long-form Video-to-Text Summarization using Recursive Language Models
papers.summary: While VideoLLMs have made significant progress in understanding short video benchmarks, they often struggle to summarize long-form ones. This is mainly due to performance degradation caused by long-context prompts, the inherent difficulty of preserving temporal continuity and a lack of semantically rich concepts in event descriptions. To tackle these issues, this paper introduces the first recursive Video Language Summarization Model (RVLSM) designed for video processing and tailored to long-form video-to-text summarization. RVLSM recursively decomposes videos into semantically coherent segments and delegates chunk-level reasoning to VideoLLM sub-models and external tools. It employs (1) Semantic Temporal Decomposition (STD), which preserves temporal coherence and continuity through a scene-aware chunking strategy that dynamically partitions videos according to semantic boundaries, and (2) Adaptive Multimodal Tool Calling (AMTC), which ensures semantic richness of the summary via a routing mechanism that selectively invokes auxiliary modules such as action recognition, optical character recognition, automatic speech recognition, and object detection. Experiments on the VideoXum and MixTyVSum benchmarks show that RVLSM consistently improves over zero-shot VideoLLM baselines across multiple model settings and performance metrics, and is competitive with a state-of-the-art fine-tuned model for video-to-text summarization. Importantly, the named entities in the RVLSM's summaries align more closely with those detected in the ground-truth summaries than those detected by baseline and state-of-the-art methods, confirming the saliency of the event descriptions it generates.
papers.zh_summary: 针对VideoLLM在长视频摘要上的性能退化、时序连续性保持困难及事件描述语义贫乏问题，提出首个递归视频语言摘要模型RVLSM。该模型递归地将视频分解为语义连贯片段，把块级推理解耦给VideoLLM子模型与外部工具，包含语义时序分解（STD）与自适应多模态工具调用（AMTC）。在VideoXum与MixTyVSum上稳定优于零样本VideoLLM基线，并与微调的SOTA模型相当，摘要中的命名实体与真实摘要更一致。
papers.novelty: 以递归分解加外部工具调用的方式规避长上下文提示退化，将长视频摘要重构为分块推理与工具路由的组合问题。
innovation_points: 语义时序分解STD：基于场景感知的动态分块，保持时序连贯与连续
自适应多模态工具调用AMTC：按需路由OCR、ASR、动作识别、目标检测等模块以丰富摘要语义
在多个模型设置与指标上系统性验证递归框架相对零样本基线的提升
papers.limitations: ['依赖外部工具与子模型的可用性与质量，错误会在递归链路中累积', '分块与路由带来额外调用开销，实时性未评估', '命名实体一致性仅在摘要层面度量，细粒度事实性错误未系统分析']
improvement_directions: 量化工具调用链的错误传播，设计校验或回退机制
研究分块边界对摘要忠实度的影响，并与端到端长上下文模型对比成本
将OCR工具输出与视觉信息做显式对齐，以改善屏幕文本密集视频的摘要质量
papers.engineering_value: 提供可插拔工具路由的长视频理解框架，便于在现有VideoLLM基础上增量集成OCR/ASR能力，适合视频内容分析与归档场景。
papers.why_relevant: AMTC明确将OCR作为可选工具之一，与OCR在视频/文档多模态理解中的下游集成直接相关。
